stem.text: Cyclohexene, as shown in the diagram, can form an addition polymer.

stem.label: cyclohexene
stem.alt: Skeletal formula of cyclohexene: a six-membered ring with one C=C double bond

stem.text: Which structure represents a section of the polymer?

A.alt: Two six-membered rings joined by a single bond, with dashed continuation bonds at both outer ends

B.alt: Two six-membered rings joined by a single bond, with dashed continuation bonds at outer positions

C.alt: Two six-membered rings joined by a single bond in a diagonal arrangement, with dashed continuation bonds

D.alt: Two six-membered rings sharing a central vertex (spiro-type), with dashed continuation bonds at both outer ends
